Irrespectueux, despectueux, méprisant, qui manque de respect.

examples.text: Sein despektierliches Verhalten gegenüber den Arbeitern war die Hauptursache für den Streik.
examples.translation: Son comportement méprisant envers les travailleurs a été la cause principale de la grève.

glosses: ohne Respekt, mit einem gewissen Grad an Missachtung

examples.text: Er hat in despektierlicher Weise über mich gesprochen.
„Für einen Großteil der Franzosen bleibt das Recht, sich auch despektierlich über Religionen äußern zu können, ein hohes Gut.“

„Ed Catmull ist der Inbegriff dessen, was man im Amerikanischen etwas despektierlich einen ‚Geek‘ nennt: jemand, der geradezu besessen ist von technischen Möglichkeiten eines Computers, der sich in Zahlen und Programmen verlieren kann.“
„Betrachtet man Krisen als despektierliche Situationen, die man besser unter den Tisch kehrt?“
„Auch den despektierlichen Begriff vom ‚Hausfrauensport‘ hört der deutsche Olympia-Curler immer mal wieder, aber nicht mehr so oft wie früher.“
„Die Bundesregierung wies die despektierliche Äußerungen des amerikanische Kongressabgeordneten über den früheren Bundeskanzler mit ‚Deutlichkeit und Entschiedenheit‘ zurück.“

translations.source_sense_description: ohne Respekt, mit einem gewissen Grad an Missachtung

glosses: Lacking respect.
irrespective, heedless, regardless

examples.text: That alone, apart from Mr. Wyse’s old-fashioned notions on the subject, made telephoning impossible, for your summons was usually answered by his cook, who instantly began scolding the butcher irrespective and disrespectful of whom you were.

translations.source_sense_description: ohne Respekt, mit einem gewissen Grad an Missachtung

glosses: Insulting, ridiculing.

examples.text: The candidate made disparaging remarks about his opponent, but they only made him seem small for insulting a worthy adversary.

While he is reasonably effusive about inter-city travel, he is heavily disparaging of all types of stopping service, including those on otherwise busy main lines. His analysis is not entirely unsound, and he tackles some of the questions head on.
It was the latest instance of Trump using dehumanizing and disparaging rhetoric as he targets undocumented immigrants and vows mass deportations if he’s reelected.

glosses: present participle and gerund of disparage
disparagement

examples.text: I am tracked by phantoms having weird detective ways […] Men with a wintry sneer, and women with tart disparagings.

translations.source_sense_description: ohne Respekt, mit einem gewissen Grad an Missachtung

glosses: Showing contempt; expressing disdain; showing a lack of respect.

examples.text: I don't know that guy, but he just gave me a contemptuous look.
Sir George burst into a loud fit of contemptuous laughter.

The most rapid and most seductive transition in all human nature is that which attends the palliation of a ravenous appetite.[…]Can those harmless but refined fellow-diners be the selfish cads whose gluttony and personal appearance so raised your contemptuous wrath on your arrival?

glosses: Worthy of contempt; contemptible.

examples.text: Rep. Noble told GCN that she, however, had deep concern "regarding the scandalous sexual exploitation and abuse of young children by adults." Noble has called on the community to "support the efforts of the Suffolk County District Attorney's office in unraveling this contemptuous situation.

translations.source_sense_description: ohne Respekt, mit einem gewissen Grad an Missachtung

glosses: In a disrespectful manner; with a lack of respect.

examples.text: As a matter of fact its narrow ornate façade presented not a single quiet space that the eyes might rest on after a tiring attempt to follow and codify the arabesques, foliations, and intricate vermiculations of what some disrespectfully dubbed as “near-aissance.”
She became disrespectfully referred to locally as the "Crab" on account of her extraordinary manoeuvrability.

translations.source_sense_description: ohne Respekt, mit einem gewissen Grad an Missachtung

glosses: Lacking respect; not having or not showing respect for or seriousness towards something that is usually treated with respect; going against conventional precepts.

examples.text: an irreverent new work
an irreverent examination of reviewing
Beyond the hut a clump of myalls loomed spectral and wraith-like, and round them a gang of crows cawed noisily, irreverent of the great silence.

translations.source_sense_description: ohne Respekt, mit einem gewissen Grad an Missachtung

glosses: Showing disregard, indicating rejection, serving to dismiss.

examples.text: I was openly dismissive about transubstantiation, by which the host is consecrated, and according to Catholic doctrine, literally turns from mere bread into the body of Christ. “But all the atoms stay the same!” I would insist. “That makes no sense!”

translations.source_sense_description: ohne Respekt, mit einem gewissen Grad an Missachtung

glosses: Showing disrespect through a casual attitude, levity, and a lack of due seriousness; pert.

examples.text: a sort of flippant, vain discourse
The conversations had grown more adult over the years—she was less flippant, at least.
In the mid-1950s we both wrote for the same weekly, where her contributions were a good deal more serious and less flippant than mine.
Our society treats smoking flippantly as a slightly distasteful habit that can injure your health. It is not. It is drug addiction.

glosses: Loquacious; speaking with ease and rapidity.

examples.text:
November 5, 1673, Isaac Barrow, sermon on the Gunpowder Treason
It becometh good men, in such cases, to be pleasantly flippant and free in their speech.

glosses: Nimble; limber.

translations.source_sense_description: ohne Respekt, mit einem gewissen Grad an Missachtung
ohne Respekt, mit einem gewissen Grad an Missachtung

glosses: Qui manque au respect, ou qui blesse le respect.

examples.text: Le mot de Renan à propos de Louis-Philippe : « Il faut pardonner aux rois leur médiocrité ; ils ne se sont pas choisis » n’est pas nécessairement irrespectueux.
Il se montra fort irrespectueux envers son supérieur.
Contenance irrespectueuse.
Propos irrespectueux.

translations.source_sense_description: ohne Respekt, mit einem gewissen Grad an Missachtung

glosses: Qui marque du mépris.

examples.text: Quoique très instruite, elle n'avoit ni les caprices, ni l’humeur qu'on attribue aux gens de lettres, qui tantôt se livrent à une loquacité importune, tantôt se renferment dans un silence méprisant.

Vous avez, docteur, de bien curieuses fréquentations, dit-il d'un ton un peu méprisant, un représentant de ces mauvais moines adorateurs du démon ! Que les Chinois sérieux estiment un peu plus qu'un soldat, mais un peu moins qu'une prostituée !
Il suffit de faire un tour sous des posts récents des chercheuses pour lire un certain nombre de réponses méprisantes ou dénialistes.

glosses: Participe présent du verbe mépriser.

examples.text: Quelle catin! et il éprouvait un furieux besoin de se venger d'elle, sans motif, en la méprisant.
